source: make a clicker game where you tap for clicks and I want a VERY DETAILED map that I can walk around in, give me a button on my screen called adminenpanel that only I HAVE and make it so I can do events and give clicks, there is to be no labels around the map or on the ground and I want a rebirth button on my screen and rebirthing doubles how much you get per click

answers.ask: You asked for a very detailed map but did not say what it is - a city, a forest, an island, something else?
answers.answer: Make it a detailed modern city map, with streets, buildings, parks, and interior-style decorative detail but no labels placed around the map or on the ground.

answers.ask: How big should the walkable area be - a plaza, a neighbourhood, or a whole world?
answers.answer: Use a neighbourhood-sized walkable area so it feels detailed and explorable while staying focused for the clicker game.

--- clarifications from the author ---
- [theme] You asked for a very detailed map but did not say what it is - a city, a forest, an island, something else? Make it a detailed modern city map, with streets, buildings, parks, and interior-style decorative detail but no labels placed around the map or on the ground.
- [scale] How big should the walkable area be - a plaza, a neighbourhood, or a whole world? Use a neighbourhood-sized walkable area so it feels detailed and explorable while staying focused for the clicker game.
config.genre_evidence: The core loop is explicitly a clicker: "tap for clicks" with a "rebirth button" where "rebirthing doubles how much you get per click," which is incremental/idle Simulation. The neighbourhood-sized detailed city is walkable and explorable, but it has no stated quests, collectibles, or landmark objective, so exploration is secondary rather than the layout's main job.
config.evidence: "a detailed modern city map, with streets, buildings, parks" and a "neighbourhood-sized walkable area"
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Simulation map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Static Settlement: A fixed, pre-built town with no personal property at all; personalization happens through the avatar, never property.

INCLUDE:
- Progression Circulation: Walkable or drivable circulation chaining the hub to wherever value is actually produced.
